entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-03

  • [API Proposal]: Add Reflection.Emit support for aligned RVA fields. #136903
  • [wasm][AOT] .NET 11 RC3: invalid LLVM IR ("PHINode should have one entry for each predecessor") for an enum local assigned in a foreach and read with ToString() after it #136896

    Future
  • Test failure: CollectibleTLSStaticCollection Timed Out #136891
